Samir: Hey team — need 2x LGTM on PR #8214 (kv-cache scheduling shim). Cutoff in ~45m. This is a small scheduling priority change to avoid stalls during warmup; low-risk but blocks tonight's hotfix window.

Jess: Can you paste the CI link + short risk summary? quick check only.

Samir: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8214
Summary: adjust scheduler to prefer prefix warmup tasks for short-lived models. Risk: low — touches selector naming + adds unit test. Manual: ran local kv-warmup e2e (no regressions). Patch: cherry-pick 9f3b2d.

deploy-bot: CI status: master-tests (✓), integration-kv (✓), perf-regress (✓) — all green.

Morgan: I can take a quick second look. I'll focus on selector logic and the test edgecases.

Leo: Left one tiny nit inline (naming), otherwise looks fine to me. doesn't affect runtime.

Morgan: Reviewed. LGTM after Leo's nit is addressed — selector name suggestion: prioritizer -> warmup_prioritizer. Also add a one-line comment about tie-breaker behavior.

Samir: Thanks — pushed fix: renamed selector and added comment, force-pushed update to PR.

Tay: LGTM. @Samir I'll be standing by for the cutover window. :thumbsup:

Samir: Awesome — two LGTM obtained. I'll hold for 10m for any objections, then merge and kick off canary.

Jess: Please post a short note in #releases when canary starts.

Samir: Will do. merging in 5.

deploy-bot: Merged by Samir at 1732110200. Canary job started: canary-rolling-kv-01.

Samir: Canary healthy at +10m. No errors observed. Rolling to prod in 10m.

Tay: Thanks — monitoring dashboards look clean. :eyes:
